The '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were distinguished by their rounded,<ref name="CW21" /> bean-shaped bodies, with thin limbs,<ref name="Spy Girls" /> [[Color/Legends|pink]]<ref name="CW21" /> or brown<ref name="Spy Girls" /> skin, and striations running across their body, extending out from their face. The species possessed large [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] with yellow sclera and beady black pupils,<ref name="CW21" /> as well as dark red<ref name="Spy Girls" /> or grayish-brown lips, and pointed [[Ear/Legends|ears]].<ref name="CW21" />

Some members of the species possessed pointed [[Nose/Legends|noses]] and exposed lower [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]],<ref name="CW21" /> while others had spherical [[Nose/Legends|noses]] instead.<ref name="Spy Girls" /> At least one member of this species was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="CW21" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 6">{{FactFile2014|6|22 BBY 75-80|Dark Side Influence}} dates the [[Hunt for the Decimator]], the [[Dark Reaper crisis]], the [[First Battle of Kamino]], the [[battle of Ohma-D'un]], the [[battle of Pengalan IV]], ''[[Jedi: Mace Windu]]'', and the events of ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' up until the [[Battle of Hypori]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], in that order.</ref> while another visited [[Bezz Drexx's tower]] around the same time during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Spy Girls" />
